title: Dinosaur Valley RV Park

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Every RV site at Dinosaur Valley RV Park includes full hookups with 30 amp and 50 amp service, water, and on‑site sewer. All sites are 80‑foot pull‑throughs, giving you plenty of room for big rigs, tow vehicles, and easy arrival and departure. Dinosaur Valley RV Park is located on the Paluxy River in Glen Rose, Texas, next to Dinosaur Valley State Park. All RV sites are within walking distance of the river, two swimming pools, an adult-only hot tub, and the trailhead into the state park. Fossil Rim Wildlife Center and downtown Glen Rose are a short drive from the park. Rates vary by date and availability. Select your dates and click Check Availability to view current pricing. blurb: Welcome to Dinosaur Valley RV Park - your family’s basecamp for adventure along the beautiful Paluxy River. Our park sits on land rich with history, from ancient dinosaur tracks to the Native American tribes who later lived throughout this region. Today, we honor that heritage with a nostalgic frontier‑style atmosphere paired with the modern comforts travelers expect.
